instruction: Change the LibreOffice Impress settings so the recent documents list contains 15 entries.

metadata.explanation: This task requires changing the number of recent documents shown in the File menu from default to 15. The evaluator checks the registrymodifications.xcu file for the PickListSize value under /org.openoffice.Office.Common/History. Similar complexity to original - both involve navigating to Tools > Options and changing a single numeric value.

Metric correctly compares the extracted value against the expected count of 15
